column3: The verse is difficult; NKJV renders “He rages against all wise judgment” for “he bursts out against all sound wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים (“like tasty morsels”) is rendered “like tasty trifles,” and “the chambers of the belly” “the inmost body.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a master of destruction” is rendered “a great destroyer.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְנִשְׂגָּב (“is set on high”) is rendered “are safe.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “seems” and “Until.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “is harder to win.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the hand of the tongue” is rendered “in the power of the tongue.”
NKJV renders “a man of companions [comes] to ruin” as “A man who has friends must himself be friendly,” following a different reading of the verb.
